name: Death of Rapstar, A Goldbear Case
source:
One night, when you’d rather be drinking in your office, your assistant drags you to an awards show and afterparty. Apparently, you need more clients, and she’s got an in. 

Everything is going fine and dandy until the host is murdered, and now you’ve got to work off the clock to find the killer.

[From [url=https://twistedchickengames.itch.io/death-of-rapstar-a-goldbear-case]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一天晚上，当你想在办公室喝酒时，你的助理拉着你去参加颁奖典礼和余兴派对。显然，你需要更多的客户，而她已经加入了。

一切都很顺利，直到主人被谋杀，现在你必须加班加点地找到凶手。

[来自[url=https://twistedchickengames.itch.io/death-of-rapstar-a-goldbear-case]Itch.io[/url]]
